Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were
involved in in League City, Texas. Do you understand that this conversation is being recorded?
A: Yes, I understand.
Q: Please state your full name and the address where you currently receive mail.
A: I'd ratehr just give the address. I live in League City, and my mail goes to the house on the corner lot.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe what you were doing right before the collision?
A: I was driving home from the store. It was a weekday afternoon, and traffic was moderate. I was in the right lane
heading down a two-lane road with a slight curve.
Q: What happened next?
A: The other car came across into my lane. I think they were trying to pass something or they swerved. I braked and
turned a little to the right, but we still hit nose to nose. It wasn't a hard impact. My airbags didn't deploy.
Q: How fast were you traveling?
A: I'd guess around thirty miles an hour, maybe a bit less because I had already started slowing down.
Q: Did you have any injuries at the scene?
A: Not right away. My neck felt stiff, and by that evening my lower back was sore. I went to urgent care the next
morning.
Q: Have you been seen by any medical provider since then?
A: Yes, I've had a few follow-up visits. They diagnosed a neck and back strain and gave me some exercises and
medication. I still get some stiffness when I turn my head quickly.
Q: Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm still trying to get back to normal, and I'm willing to provide my medical records whenever you need
them.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
</page>
